title: Grilled Australian Vegetable Skewers
description: A delicious and healthy outdoor dish, perfect for a summer barbecue. The combination of Australian vegetables and a hint of smokiness from the grill will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Soak 10 wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the zucchini, bell pepper, onion, mushrooms, and tomato onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with Australian-style barbecue sauce during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
